'''Fudbalski klub Voždovac''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|Фудбалски клуб Вождовац}}) is a professional football club based in [[Voždovac]], Belgrade, Serbia, which competes in the [[Serbian First League]], the second tier.

Nicknamed "The Dragons", they experienced little success in the Yugoslavian era, but have become one of Belgrade's best and most stable clubs in modern times since Serbia's independence.

They are known for their [[Voždovac Stadium|stadium]] on top of the shopping center.<ref>{{Cite web |title=СТАДИОН ФК ВОЖДОВАЦ |url=https://fkvozdovac.rs/stadion/ |access-date=2023-07-08 |website=Фудбалски клуб Вождовац - Football Club Voždovac |language=sr-RS}}</ref>"}}
